about: Plain-word tasks Sean does in Admin. Each starts on one view, has a success condition in plain words, and budgets for taps, words on screen and time to the first decision. FE-37 runs them with a minted session, using the same measurements and look reviewer as the resident tasks. No task names a particular place.

tasks.title: Start a mission
tasks.success: Sean can see where to start a mission, say what it is for, and see that it was accepted.

tasks.title: Shift focus to a different place or kind of work
tasks.success: Sean can change what the team works on first and see the change take effect in the queue.

tasks.title: Schedule an order for later
tasks.success: Sean can give an order a time and see it waiting on the list with that time.

tasks.title: Find out why something is slow
tasks.success: Sean can see which part is slow and the reason in a sentence, without reading a log.

tasks.title: Read what the team fixed today
tasks.success: Sean can read today's fixes in plain words, newest first, each with what it changes for a reader.

tasks.title: Decide on a new expense
tasks.success: Sean can see what a new expense is for and what it costs against the budget, and approve or refuse it.
